{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Now, print each number exactly as it will appear in evidence
# We must print the raw values so they can be used in evidence
print(n_loyal)
print(converted_loyal)
print(fraction_converted)"}
